structured.reason: The pool has one worker and only one future is submitted. When shutdown runs, that future is either finished (success or route error) or already cancelled by future.cancel() or running (timeout), so the queue has nothing left for cancel_futures to cancel. Timeout, fallback and success behave the same either way; only an interrupt such as Ctrl+C before the task starts would differ, and the requirement does not cover that.
